AboutPage.metaDescription: Learn about Rizzma — a local restaurant in Vienna serving fresh pizza, burgers, and salads with fast delivery across Austria.
AboutPage.title: Good food, made with heart in Vienna
AboutPage.subtitle: Rizzma started as a small neighbourhood kitchen and grew into a place locals trust for honest food and reliable delivery.
AboutPage.storyTitle: From a single oven to your doorstep
AboutPage.storyParagraph1: Rizzma opened in 2018 with one goal: serve food we'd proudly bring to our own table. What began as a compact restaurant on Mariahilfer Straße quickly became a favourite for families, students, and late-night cravings across Vienna.
AboutPage.storyParagraph2: Today we prepare every pizza, burger, and salad to order — whether you dine in, pick up, or get it delivered. We source fresh ingredients locally where we can, and our team treats every order like it's the only one that matters.

fresh.title: Fresh ingredients
fresh.description: Quality produce, house-made sauces, and dough prepared daily — never frozen, never rushed.

delivery.title: Fast & reliable delivery
delivery.description: Hot food at your door in 25–40 minutes across Vienna, with real-time updates on your order.

passion.title: Made with passion
passion.description: Our chefs take pride in every plate. It's not fast food — it's good food, fast.

AboutPage.ctaSubtitle: Browse our menu and order your favourites — delivery or pickup, your choice.

ContactPage.metaDescription: Get in touch with Rizzma. Visit us in Vienna, call us, or send a message — we'd love to hear from you.

ContactPage.subtitle: Questions about an order, catering, or just want to say hello? Reach out — we typically reply within a few hours.
ContactPage.formSubtitle: Fill in the form and our team will get back to you shortly.

ReviewsPage.metaDescription: See what customers say about Rizzma. Real reviews from pizza, burger, and delivery orders.
ReviewsPage.title: What our guests say
ReviewsPage.subtitle: Thousands of orders delivered — here's what people think about Rizzma.

sarah.name: Sarah M.
sarah.text: Best pizza in town! The Margherita arrived hot and the crust was perfectly crispy. Delivery was faster than expected too.

marco.name: Marco R.
marco.text: The Classic Rizzma Burger is incredible — juicy patty, fresh toppings, and the sauce is addictive. Will definitely order again.

elena.name: Elena K.
elena.text: Great salads and quick delivery. The Greek salad was fresh and generous. Only wish the dressing came on the side, but still 4 stars!

thomas.name: Thomas W.
thomas.text: Ordered for a family dinner — pepperoni pizza, two burgers, and sides. Everything was spot on. Rizzma is our new go-to.

julia.name: Julia H.
julia.text: Love that I can order in English and German. Food quality is restaurant-level and the packaging keeps everything warm. Highly recommend!
